ex: A hackerspace is a shared room where people build and fix things.
Our local hackerspace has 3D printers and soldering tools.
You can join the hackerspace for a small monthly fee.
On Fridays, the hackerspace runs free classes for beginners.
Carnauba is a wax from the leaves of a Brazilian palm tree.
This car polish contains carnauba to make the paint shine.
Carnauba wax is also used to coat candy and pills.
Rub the carnauba wax onto the wood with a soft cloth.
Trumpism is a political movement named after a US president.
The book explains the rise of Trumpism in small towns.
Some voters liked Trumpism because of its anti-elite message.
The article compares Trumpism with other populist movements.
trumpism.note: Usually written with a capital letter: Trumpism.

ex: Granita is a Sicilian frozen dessert made from sugar, water, and fruit.
On hot days, we have lemon granita for breakfast.
Can I have a coffee granita with cream, please?
Stir the granita with a fork every hour while it freezes.
A Malinois is a Belgian shepherd dog that is smart and active.
The police use a Malinois to find drugs at the airport.
Our Malinois needs at least two hours of exercise every day.
A Malinois looks a bit like a German shepherd, but it is lighter.
malinois.note: Often written with a capital letter: a Belgian Malinois.

ex: The Brexiter said leaving the EU would bring back control.
My uncle is a proud Brexiter and talks about it often.
Brexiters and Remainers argued on television all evening.
The poll found that many Brexiters were older voters.
brexiter.note: British, informal; usually written with a capital B, often as Brexiteer.

ex: The ichthys is a simple fish symbol used by Christians.
Early Christians drew an ichthys to show their faith in secret.
He has a small ichthys sticker on the back of his car.
The ichthys is made of two curved lines that look like a fish.
In this shooter game, a killstreak gives you extra rewards.
I lost my killstreak when another player hit me from behind.
A ten-player killstreak lets you call in a helicopter.
Her longest killstreak in the online match was fifteen.
A triacylglycerol is the main type of fat stored in the body.
Most of the fat we eat is triacylglycerol.
The blood test measures your triacylglycerol level after fasting.
Each triacylglycerol is made of glycerol and three fatty acids.
A turbidite is a rock layer left by an underwater mudslide.
Geologists found many turbidite layers in the cliff by the sea.
Each turbidite starts with coarse sand and ends with fine mud.
Turbidite beds can tell us about old earthquakes under the ocean.
Dextromethorphan is a common medicine that helps stop a dry cough.
This cough syrup contains dextromethorphan, so read the label.
Do not take dextromethorphan with some antidepressants.
Ask the pharmacist how much dextromethorphan a child can take.

hoster.note: "Hosting provider" or "web host" is more common.

ex: The vet gave ivermectin to the horse for worms.
Ivermectin is used to treat river blindness and head lice.
The doctor prescribed ivermectin cream for my skin problem.
Never take ivermectin made for animals; ask your doctor first.
Tamago is a sweet Japanese omelet made in thin rolled layers.
Can I get one piece of tamago sushi, please?
The chef cut the tamago into small yellow blocks.
Kids often like tamago because it tastes sweet and soft.
An old television used a kinescope to show the picture.
The kinescope in that old TV set is very heavy.
When the kinescope gets old, the picture looks dark.
The repairman said the kinescope in our TV was burned out.
kinescope.note: Also, in the US, a film recording of an early TV show.

ex: An alkoxide forms when an alcohol loses a hydrogen atom.
Sodium ethoxide is a common alkoxide used in the lab.
The chemist added the alkoxide slowly because it reacts with water.
Keep the alkoxide in a dry, closed bottle.
A mutualist is a living thing that helps another and gets help back.
Bees are mutualists of flowers because both of them gain something.
The fungus is a mutualist that helps the tree roots get water.
In our biology class, we listed examples of each mutualist.
Tempranillo is a red wine grape from Spain.
Could we have a bottle of tempranillo with dinner?
This tempranillo tastes of cherry and a little vanilla.
Tempranillo goes well with grilled meat and hard cheese.
Triumphalism is the attitude of loudly celebrating a win over others.
The coach warned the team against triumphalism after one good game.
Critics disliked the triumphalism of the minister's victory speech.
There was no triumphalism in her quiet thank-you to the voters.
Injera is a soft, sour flatbread from Ethiopia.
At the Ethiopian restaurant, we ate stew with injera.
Tear off a piece of injera and use it to pick up food.
Injera is made from teff flour and water.
In Tibetan Buddhism, a dakini is a female spirit of wisdom.
The painting shows a dancing dakini in red.
Our guide explained what the dakini means in Buddhist art.
The temple has a small statue of a dakini near the door.
A dipeptide is made of two amino acids joined together.
Your body breaks proteins down into dipeptides and single amino acids.
The sweetener aspartame is a dipeptide.
In the lab, we made a simple dipeptide from two amino acids.
A groupset is the set of gears and brakes on a bike.
I want to upgrade the groupset on my road bike.
This bike comes with a cheap but reliable groupset.
A new groupset can cost more than the frame.
Overbooking happens when an airline sells more seats than the plane has.
Because of overbooking, we had to wait for the next flight.
The hotel apologized for the overbooking and gave us a free room.
Overbooking is common on busy holiday weekends.
Iberico ham comes from black pigs raised in Spain.
Can we order a plate of Iberico ham to share?
Iberico pork is more expensive than regular pork.
The shop sells thin slices of Iberico for special dinners.
iberico.note: Usually written with a capital letter: Iberico ham.

ex: Barbacoa is Mexican meat slowly cooked until it is very soft.
Can I get two tacos with barbacoa, please?
My uncle makes barbacoa with beef cheeks on weekends.
The barbacoa is cooked for many hours in a covered pot.
Xanthan is a powder that makes sauces and dressings thicker.
Gluten-free bread often needs a little xanthan gum.
Add a pinch of xanthan to keep the ice cream smooth.
Check the label: this salad dressing contains xanthan.
xanthan.note: Usually used in the phrase "xanthan gum."

ex: Bacalhau is dried salted cod, popular in Portugal.
Soak the bacalhau in water for two days before you cook it.
At Christmas, my friend's family eats bacalhau with potatoes.
Can you recommend a good bacalhau dish on the menu?
A teraflop is a trillion calculations per second.
This new game console can do about ten teraflops.
The supercomputer's speed is measured in teraflops.
More teraflops usually mean better graphics in games.
After the concert, fans waited for the aftershow at a nearby club.
The band met a few fans at the aftershow.
Do we need a separate ticket for the aftershow?
The TV channel streams a short aftershow after each episode.
Sard is a brownish-red stone, a kind of chalcedony.
The old ring has a carved sard instead of a diamond.
Sard was popular for seals and cameos in ancient times.
The jeweler showed us a polished sard in warm brown colors.
An eruv is a boundary that lets Jewish people carry things on the Sabbath.
The eruv around the neighborhood is marked by a thin wire.
The rabbi checks the eruv every Friday before the Sabbath.
If the eruv is broken, families cannot push strollers outside.
A physicalist believes everything is physical, including the mind.
As a physicalist, she thinks thoughts are just brain activity.
The physicalist and the religious student debated in class.
Many scientists today are physicalists, but not all philosophers are.
A polynucleotide is a long chain of nucleotides, like DNA or RNA.
DNA is made of two polynucleotide strands.
The enzyme joins short pieces into one long polynucleotide.
Some skin creams now contain a polynucleotide from fish.
Silat is a martial art from Southeast Asia.
My cousin takes silat classes twice a week in Jakarta.
Silat uses fast kicks, strikes, and throws.
Is there a silat club near our school?
Dorada is a white sea fish with a mild taste.
Can I have the grilled dorada with salad, please?
The market sells fresh dorada from Greek fish farms.
Bake the dorada with lemon and olive oil.
An endophyte is a fungus or bacterium that lives inside a plant.
This grass has an endophyte that protects it from insects.
The endophyte does not harm the plant; it often helps it.
Scientists found a new endophyte in the leaves of the tree.
The gamemaster tells the story and makes the rules in the game.
Tonight I am the gamemaster for our board game group.
Ask the gamemaster if your character can open the door.
A good gamemaster keeps every player interested.
An isozyme is one of several forms of the same enzyme.
The heart and the liver have different isozymes of this enzyme.
The blood test checks which isozyme is high.
Each isozyme does the same job but works best in a different tissue.
A mandapa is a hall with pillars in a Hindu temple.
People gather in the mandapa before entering the main shrine.
The wedding took place under a decorated mandapa.
The mandapa has beautiful carvings on every column.
Fuzzing means testing a program with lots of random input.
Fuzzing found a bug that made the app crash.
We run fuzzing on the new parser every night.
Fuzzing is a common way to find security problems in software.
Escitalopram is a medicine for depression and anxiety.
My doctor started me on a low dose of escitalopram.
Escitalopram may take a few weeks to start working.
Do not stop taking escitalopram suddenly without asking your doctor.
Melena is black, sticky stool caused by bleeding in the stomach.
The doctor asked if I had melena after taking the pills.
Melena can be a sign of a stomach ulcer.
Go to the hospital if you notice melena.
Nubuck is soft leather with a velvet-like surface.
These boots are made of brown nubuck.
Use a special brush to clean nubuck shoes.
Nubuck gets dirty quickly, so spray it before you wear it.
Drosera catches insects with sticky drops on its leaves.
I keep a small drosera on my kitchen windowsill.
Water your drosera with rainwater, not tap water.
Drosera grows naturally in wet bogs and marshes.
A matroid is a math structure that describes independence in sets.
Our algorithms course used matroids to explain greedy methods.
The professor gave a simple example of a matroid from graphs.
Matroid theory connects linear algebra and graph theory.
Gavage is feeding through a tube that goes into the stomach.
The premature baby received milk by gavage.
In the lab, the mice got the drug by gavage.
Foie gras is made by gavage of ducks and geese.
In Ayurveda, a dosha is one of three types of body energy.
The doctor said my main dosha is vata.
Ayurvedic food plans are based on your dosha.
Take a short online quiz to find your dosha.
Imipramine is an old medicine for depression.
The doctor prescribed imipramine to help the child stop bedwetting.
Imipramine can cause a dry mouth and sleepiness.
Don't drink alcohol while you are taking imipramine.
A maquiladora is a factory in Mexico that assembles goods for export.
She works at a maquiladora near the US border.
The maquiladora builds car parts for foreign companies.
Many maquiladoras pay low wages for long hours.
The psoas is a deep muscle that connects your spine to your legs.
Sitting all day can make your psoas tight.
This yoga stretch helps to relax the psoas.
The physical therapist found a problem with my psoas.
Psyllium is a plant fiber that helps with digestion.
Mix a spoon of psyllium into a glass of water.
Drink plenty of water when you take psyllium.
Psyllium husk is often used in gluten-free baking.
Itraconazole is a medicine that treats fungal infections.
The doctor prescribed itraconazole for my nail fungus.
Take itraconazole capsules with a full meal.
Itraconazole can interact with many other drugs.
A kinetochore is a protein structure on a chromosome.
During cell division, fibers attach to the kinetochore.
If a kinetochore fails, the cell can get the wrong chromosomes.
The microscope image shows each kinetochore as a bright dot.
A tergite is a hard plate on the back of an insect.
Each segment of the beetle's body has its own tergite.
The scientist counted the tergites on the ant's abdomen.
The colors of the tergites help identify this wasp.
Rotenone is a natural poison made from the roots of some plants.
Farmers once used rotenone to kill insects on vegetables.
The lake was treated with rotenone to remove invasive fish.
Rotenone is very toxic to fish, so keep it away from ponds.
A refugium is a place where plants and animals survive hard times.
The valley was a refugium during the ice age.
Cold mountain streams are a refugium for some fish.
The small island is a refugium for rare birds.
The generator is rated at fifty kilovolt-amperes.
We need a transformer of at least 100 kilovolt-amperes.
On equipment labels, kilovolt-ampere is written as kVA.
Check the kilovolt-ampere rating before you buy a backup power unit.
A cuber solves puzzle cubes for fun or in competitions.
The young cuber solved the cube in eight seconds.
Hundreds of cubers met at the weekend tournament.
He became a cuber after watching online videos.
A pseudogene is a broken copy of a gene that does not work.
Humans have a pseudogene for making vitamin C.
Scientists study each pseudogene to learn about evolution.
The test confused the real gene with a pseudogene.
Spirea is a garden bush with small white or pink flowers.
We planted a row of spirea along the fence.
Cut back the spirea after it finishes blooming.
Spirea grows well in full sun and needs little care.
Squalene is an oil found in shark liver and olive oil.
This face cream contains squalene to keep skin soft.
Some vaccines use squalene to make them work better.
The body uses squalene to make cholesterol.
The fornix is a band of nerve fibers deep in the brain.
Damage to the fornix can cause memory problems.
The scan showed a small injury near the fornix.
The fornix connects the memory center to other parts of the brain.
